imageGallery.$description: Corner radius of the frame around the pictures of the image gallery. It is the `container` radius role, the same as the featured media card (ADR-0050, ADR-0066).
Stroke width of the frame around the pictures, and of the outline of a dot (BR-13).

bg.$description: Fill behind the pictures: the pure black page (BR-03, ADR-0053), through `color.surface.card`. Any space around a picture is this black (ADR-0056).

highlight.$description: The neon highlight of the gallery: its frame is brand pink, like the cards (BR-01, ADR-0018, ADR-0026).

border.$description: Outline of the dot of a picture that is not showing: the neutral border color, which passes the 3:1 minimum for a UI element.

borderHover.$description: Outline of a dot under the pointer: brand pink, as the outline of a pagination page does on hover (ADR-0028).

current.$description: Fill and outline of the dot of the picture that is showing. A filled dot against hollow ones, so the current picture is not told by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

color.$description: Focus ring color of the gallery and of its dots (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009). It is never the glow.

width.$description: Focus ring width of the gallery and of its dots (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between the gallery or a dot and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the gallery and of its dots (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
